description: This PHP source file defines the Currency controller class in the OpenCart admin module, responsible for managing currency-related tasks such as listing currencies, refreshing exchange rates, creating and clearing JSON currency files.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Controller class for managing currency-related tasks in the OpenCart admin interface, including listing, refreshing, and clearing currency data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Sets up scheduled tasks for clearing and listing currencies.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates a JSON file containing the list of currencies.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Updates currency exchange rates and schedules the currency task.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes existing JSON currency files for all languages.
